PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 
 
Investment Banking Analyst with experience in assisting clients with trade Processing & Reconciliation, Mergers, 
Corporate Actions, NAV Activity, Fund Accounting, and financial reporting. Proficient in handling complex trade 
activity and reconciliation wi th Investment Manager v/s Broker. Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to 
effectively communicate complex financial concepts. Investment Banking Analyst with expertise in conducting due 
diligence and managing client relationships. 
 
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE 
 
Associate II | State Street 
July 2022 - Present | ETD DERIVATIVES F&O 
 
● Derivatives-Processing and reconciliation (Futures and Options). 
● Handling critical merger activity, corporate actions, expiry & assignments. 
● Carry out basic and complex trade processing and reconciliation functions in accordance with established procedures. 
● Calculating NAV impact to mitigate the risk. 
● Supported daily NAV preparation and validation by assessing the impact of trade activity, pricing, cash movements, 
corporate actions, and reconciliation breaks on fund NAV. 
● Performed daily cash and position reconciliation between Investment Manager, broker, and internal accounting records, 
investigating breaks and ensuring resolution prior to NAV finalization. 
● Managed end-to-end trade settlement activities including trade matching, confirmation/affirmation, settlement monitoring, 
failed trade investigation, and exception resolution across broker and custody workflows. 
● Performed daily Fund Accounting activities for assigned funds, including review of fund transactions, cash activity, 
income, expenses, and investment positions to support accurate NAV preparation. 
● Perform futures cash activity and manage cash exceptions (TLP). 
● Playing vital role in new fund onboarding. 
● Processing trades sent by Investment Managers to OTC Hub and MCH. 
● Tracking ending cash balances from the broker and booking cash movements. 
● Performing reconciliation Investment Manager VS Broker. 
● Preparation and delivery of valuation reports to internal and external clients and/or agents in a timely manner. 
● Identify, research and resolve pricing breaking set tolerance levels. 
● Reviewing/auditing trades processed by other team members to ensure accuracy. 
● Perform and review global pricing tasks in a continuous operations environment. 
● Managing query in timely manner 
● Cash and Forex posting 
● Review and approve pricing packages/checklists with a focus on accuracy & detail.

& External) | Risk Identification & Mitigation | Deadline Management | Broker Conversion.
